title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Return Credits for Selling-Program Refunds — Systems Reference Card
content:
**Rule.** When a Ridgeline selling program has issued a refund to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name and the account does not yet carry it, one return credit is posted for it, referencing the purchase the refund credits and carrying that purchase's plan code and the order number of the refund.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| A Ridgeline selling program (special orders, installations, tool rental or orders) shows a refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name, and the account carries no return credit for it | one return credit is posted on the account that paid for the purchase |
| The account already carries the return credit for that refund | the condition of this rule does not arise |

The return credit names three things from the records: the purchase line it credits, that purchase's financing plan, and the order, contract or agreement number under which the refund was issued.

## Capability

`post_refund_return_credit_59e816eb` posts one return credit to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account. It adds one credit line to the account ledger, dated today and placed in today's statement period, that references the original purchase, carries that purchase's financing plan and the refund's order, contract or agreement number, and lowers the amount the cardholder owes by the credited amount. The cardholder sees the credit on the account right away and on the next statement.

## How it is invoked

The tool belongs to the agent: unlock `post_refund_return_credit_59e816eb`, then call it with the parameters below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the reference number of the consumer credit account (card or project loan) that paid for the original purchase, as the account lookup returns it for the verified customer |
| `original_transaction_id` | the reference number of the purchase line on that account that the refund credits, as the account ledger lookup returns it |
| `merchant_reference` | the order, contract or agreement number of the refunded purchase exactly as it appears on the selling program's record of the refund and on the purchase line; copied character for character, letters, digits and hyphens preserved, with no reformatting, addition or deletion |
| `plan_code` | the financing plan of the purchase being credited, exactly one of the values listed below |
| `amount` | the credit amount in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the nearest cent; it is booked exactly as given |

Values of `plan_code`:

- `revolving_standard` — a purchase on the card's standard revolving balance
- `deferred_6` — a purchase on 6-month deferred-interest financing
- `deferred_12` — a purchase on 12-month deferred-interest financing
- `deferred_24` — a purchase on 24-month deferred-interest financing
- `fixed_apr_84` — a purchase on 84 fixed monthly payments at the reduced APR
- `loan_draw` — a draw on a project loan
- `not_applicable` — only for a line tied to no purchase plan, which never applies to a return credit

## Return

A receipt with: `status` — the word posted when the credit line was written; `card_transaction_id` — the reference number of the new credit line; `card_account_id` — the account credited; `amount` — the credited amount in USD with 2 decimals; `plan_code` — the plan recorded on the credit; `transaction_date` — the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD; `current_balance` — the amount owed once the credit is booked, USD with 2 decimals (negative means a credit balance).
